text:
Mina (CS): Alert — a subset of private/VPC onboarding flows are failing auth during indexing/ingest after last night's credential rotation. Affected tenants are stuck in 'auth_error' and cannot complete onboarding. Need an embargoed customer status + per-tenant ETA for high-touch list.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-499 created — onboarding auth failures after credential rotation. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-499 Severity: high.

Omar (SRE): Root cause: service-to-service token exchange endpoint started rejecting older client certs after rotation; some onboarding agents retained cached certs and hit 401s. Rolled back rotation for the affected cert pool at 02:05 UTC and restarted agents. We've paused new onboarding starts and kicked off re-auth for queued jobs.

Sam (Eng): Rollback + agent restart completed at 02:12 UTC. Re-auth sweep is running; ~70% should reconnect automatically. ~30% require manual rebind because their agent checkpoint held the stale cert. Building a rebind helper (one-off) to accelerate manual fixes; ETA ~1.5 hours to run across flagged tenants.

Omar (SRE): Uploaded per-tenant export to /shared/cs/onboard-auth-affected.csv with preliminary ETAs. Sample: tenant-mercury auto-reconnect ~15m, tenant-orion manual rebind queued ~40m, tenant-lotus re-ingest needed ~2h. I'll update every 20m.

Mina (CS): Draft short customer message for high-touch: 'We're investigating issues preventing some private/VPC onboarding jobs from completing due to an internal credential rotation. Engineering has reverted the rotation for affected agents and is re-running authentication and onboarding flows. Most customers should see recovery within 3 hours; your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Any edits?

Priya (SE): Add a clear safety line: 'No customer data or model artifacts were accessed by unauthorized parties; this was an authentication failure between internal services.' I'll prepare FR/ES translations.

Jorge (CS Manager): Approve message. Compensation options: offer opt-in 'one-week dedicated capacity credit' OR a '$400 onboarding credit' for materially impacted accounts. Also schedule live troubleshooting office hours today 4-6pm PT. Flag any renewal-risk accounts to GTM and mark for priority exec outreach.

Mina (CS): Will attach CSV + ETA column and send to priority customers in ~10m. Need a Zendesk canned reply for CS reps.

Omar (SRE): Uploaded support template: /shared/cs/templates/onboard-auth-incident.txt Suggested snippet: 'We're investigating onboarding failures after a credential rotation. Engineering has reverted the change for affected agents and initiated re-auth. Expected recovery: <ETA>. If your agent remains in auth_error after <threshold>, run the diagnostic below and attach the job id when opening a ticket.'

Priya (SE): Diagnostic command for customers to paste: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/onboard/status
# returns: {"state":"auth_error|processing|queued","last_error":"...","agent_id":"..."}```

Sam (Eng): Confirmed: no customer model weights or raw files were exposed. Full RCA and timeline will be posted after re-auth sweep completes.

Mina (CS): Sending outreach to high-touch now. I'll post final email copy + list of accounts reached and opt-ins for credits. Also adding a feedback tab to the CSV so we can capture notes from office hours. Priya — drop translations in /shared/cs/i18n when ready.

Jorge (CS Manager): Approved. Please ensure the renewal-risk escalation path includes a direct line to me for any accounts that request contract discussions.

Mina (CS): Will do. Will update thread with statuses every 30m. Thanks all :heart:
